scope: Four preselected diagnostic caregiver cases, not independent win-rate or garden viability evidence. Actual engine endings, faithful cap extension, observer neutrality and public Wait control. Existing balanced warnings stay open.

method.scope: Harness-methodology correction, not a Game balance comparison. Only public Wait replaces direct internal turn mutation. Existing policies/Game are identical.
